## Core Capabilities & Services

- [AI Voice Receptionist (24/7)](https://aiautomationny.com/services/ai-voice-receptionist): Sub-second latency, natural human-like voice agents that answer incoming phone calls, qualify leads, schedule calendar appointments, and route urgent emergencies.
- [AI Chat & Booking Systems](https://aiautomationny.com/services/ai-chat-booking): Multilingual conversational widgets for websites and SMS that capture customer intent and convert traffic into confirmed appointments.
- [CRM & Sales Pipeline Automation](https://aiautomationny.com/services/crm-sales-automation): Seamless integration with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, and custom databases with stage tracking and automated rep tasks.
- [Speed-to-Lead Instant Follow-Up](https://aiautomationny.com/services/speed-to-lead): Sub-60-second outreach via SMS and call bridge whenever a prospect submits a lead form or request.
- [Database Reactivation Campaigns](https://aiautomationny.com/services/database-reactivation): AI-powered outreach sequences that revive dormant lead databases into fresh booking revenue.
- [Multi-Agent Custom AI Architecture](https://aiautomationny.com/services/custom-ai-workflows): Tailored multi-model LLM orchestration (Gemini 2.5, OpenAI GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet) connected to internal enterprise data sources.

## Pricing & Investment Tiers

- **AI Business Starter ($2,500 setup + $397/mo)**: 4–5 page high-converting AI website, GoHighLevel CRM setup, 24/7 AI chat widget, calendar booking, up to 7 automated workflows.
- **AI Business Growth ($5,000 setup + $697/mo)**: Advanced 4–5 page AI website, multi-channel AI chatbot, missed-call text back, database reactivation, up to 15 workflows, speed-to-lead engine.
- **AI Business Pro ($8,500 setup + $1,197/mo)**: Full 24/7 AI Voice Receptionist phone system, omnichannel AI workforce, up to 30 workflows, smart routing, review generation engine.
- **AI Business Elite ($15,000+ custom)**: Custom multi-agent AI architecture, multi-location enterprise CRM, dedicated voice tuning, bespoke API integrations, SLA priority support.
